name: Framer MCP
description: Connects Claude, Codex, Cursor and other MCP clients to Framer so designers and marketers can build website pages, manage CMS content, and publish sites.

skills.name: Build and Edit Pages
skills.description: Creates new pages and updates existing layouts across desktop, tablet, and phone breakpoints, reusing the project's styles and components.

skills.name: Manage CMS Content
skills.description: Creates CMS collections and items, updates structured content, and imports content from sources the AI client can access.

skills.name: Migrate a Site
skills.description: Rebuilds a page or a full site in Framer using an existing website as the reference, ready to review and refine on the canvas.

skills.name: Review SEO
skills.description: Inspects metadata, headings, alt text, page structure, and content issues to review a Framer site's SEO and quality.

skills.name: Work on a Branch
skills.description: Creates a Framer branch and makes changes there, so they can be reviewed before merging or publishing to the live site.
